target_customer: Phase II and III clinical trial sponsors and their biometrics, data management and statistical programming teams
problem: Turning raw clinical study data into FDA-ready submission outputs (CDISC mapping, SDTM, ADaM, tables, listings, figures, QC) takes months of manual programming.
business_model: Enterprise software deployed inside the sponsor's environment with forward-deployed engineers

founders.name: Joshua Wang
education: Stanford, dropped out, studied CS and Math
founders.background_notes: YC page lists USAMO qualifier and USACO Platinum; says he built multi-agent AI and clinical data automation workflows.

founders.name: Sanmay Sarada
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built clinical and hospital data infrastructure for diagnostic software; no employer is named on the page.

competitors.name: Saama
competitors.what: AI SDTM and ADaM autogeneration for clinical data
competitors.traction_then: Won an AI Breakthrough award in 2026 per its own page; customer numbers not stated

competitors.name: Narrativa Dataset Voyager
competitors.what: AI agents that generate ADaM datasets and define.xml from validated SDTM

competitors.name: Clymb Clinical
competitors.what: Data Mapper tool for SDTM and ADaM automation
competitors.traction_then: Co-founder says customers had asked for SDTM and ADaM automation for over a year

technical_complexity.rationale: Must produce regulator-grade, auditable CDISC outputs from messy raw data and run inside sponsor environments, which needs domain depth plus reliable LLM workflows.

defensibility.rationale: Several vendors (Saama, Narrativa, Clymb) already sell similar automation; on-prem deployment and validation could create some lock-in but the company is weeks old.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to tell; no incumbent action against Astraea found as of late 2026.

market_need_then: Sponsors spend months on manual biometrics programming; 2026 vendor and conference material (PharmaSUG, Cytel, Saama) shows active demand for AI in statistical programming with human oversight.

branding.domain_note: Operates at tryastraea.com, so the exact astraea domain was not used; no acquisition story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Regulated, sober enterprise language; states it is not a CRO or CTMS and that qualified experts approve outputs.

branding.community_and_virality: No community or press about the brand itself found; the company sponsors the BBSW 2026 event as Gold Sponsor per its site.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand; several unrelated companies use the Astraea name, including a satellite analytics firm that was acquired in 2022.

outcome_analysis: Astraea is a Spring 2026 company that is still active and only weeks old at the time of research, so there is no outcome yet. Its early signals are a two person technical founding team, a focused regulated niche, and a crowded field of AI SDTM and ADaM vendors, so the main open question is whether it wins sponsor trust faster than established players.
notes: Funding unverified: yespress.io (one aggregator) mentions a $130K seed tied to the YC batch, which is likely YC's standard deal and not recorded as a round; Dealroom shows a vague $500-750k value. Other companies named Astraea (satellite analytics, Charlottesville) raised a $6.5M Series A in 2022 and are unrelated. Outcome search found no news of acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Third-party sites give team size 2 to 4 while YC says 6.
